hypotheses.statement: The settlement failure ratio increased to 0.61 due to two concurrent, independent faults: database connection pool exhaustion and feature-flag service token expiry.
The database connection pool exhaustion was caused by the settlement-worker concurrency increase from 8 to 32 workers while the pool size remained at 20.
The feature-flag service token expiry caused 401 invalid_token errors, and the worker fails closed when it cannot read the settlement_v2_enabled flag.

observed_facts.statement: Alert settlement-failures fired at 16:00:44Z with a failure ratio of 0.61 against an objective of 0.02 and cleared at 18:12:30Z.
Configuration change at 15:55:00Z raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers, while the database connection pool size remained at 20.
The service token for flags.internal expired at 15:59:00Z on 2026-02-11, and its renewal was not automated.
Database connection pool exhausted from 15:58:10Z, with pool size 20, checked-out 20, queue depth rising, and pool_timeout errors after 5000ms.
Calls to flags.internal returned 401 invalid_token from 15:59:02Z, causing the worker to fail closed when it cannot read the settlement_v2_enabled flag.
Connection pool raised to 64 at 17:20:15Z, pool_timeout errors stopped, and settlement failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29.
A replacement token for flags.internal was installed at 18:12:10Z, 401 responses stopped, and the settlement failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.
Settlement failure ratio series shows 0.61 from 16:00Z, stepping down to 0.29 at 17:20Z and to 0.004 at 18:12Z, with each step aligned with a different remediation.
INC-2201 opened at 16:05:00Z, severity 1, title 'Settlements failing', with no settlement value at risk recorded.

open_questions.missing_evidence: Documentation or configuration management records explaining why database connection pool size is not derived from worker concurrency.
open_questions.question: Why is the database connection pool size not derived from worker concurrency?

open_questions.missing_evidence: An audit of all service tokens and their renewal policies.
open_questions.question: Which other service tokens are on manual renewal and require auditing?

summary: Incident dual-cause-payments involved a settlement failure ratio spike to 0.61 due to two concurrent, independent faults: database connection pool exhaustion from increased worker concurrency and feature-flag service token expiry. The pool was exhausted at 15:58:10Z after a concurrency increase at 15:55:00Z, and the token expired at 15:59:00Z. The pool was enlarged at 17:20:15Z, reducing failures to 0.29, and a replacement token installed at 18:12:10Z resolved remaining failures, bringing the ratio to 0.004.
